titles: How Did Ancient Humans Survive Winter?
You Wouldn't Last One Ice Age Winter. Your Ancestors Did.
The Weird Clue That Reveals When You Started Wearing Clothes
description:
It is minus thirty degrees. No heater, no jacket, no door to close. And yet your ancestors survived winter after winter.

In this video you discover how early humans beat the cold: a million years of fire, a surprising clue hidden in lice that dates the first clothing, the bone needle that changed everything, and houses built from mammoth bones.

If you enjoyed this, like the video, tell us in the comments how cold your apartment is right now, and subscribe for more stories about how you became human.
